title: Tautulli Client Error Rate by App
app: Jellyfin, Emby, Steam, Steam Deck logs, Xbox and Nintendo exports, Tautulli, AntennaPod, RetroArch, and the *arr stack via official APIs, local databases, webhook payloads, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=tautulli:play
| stats count as plays, sum(eval(error="true")) as errors by client_app
| eval error_pct=round(100*errors/plays,1)
| where plays>=5 AND error_pct>5
| sort - error_pct
description: Uses Tautulli playback telemetry telemetry to monitor playback error rate for each client app in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for apps that keep breaking playback sessions, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Tautulli playback telemetry data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
grandmaExplanation: It turns playback error rate for each client app so you can spot apps that keep breaking playback sessions before it becomes annoying.
